q: What are you looking for next?
a: A role close to research, in real-world settings: staying at the frontier of robot learning and bringing it out of the lab and onto actual robots. Based in Spain and open to relocating.

q: What did your thesis on VLAs explore?
a: Fine-tuning a vision-language-action model on a real robot, then extracting expert-distilled perceptual information from its multimodal backbone and using it to steer action generation, either as regularization or as explicit guidance.

q: Have you worked with real robots?
a: Yes, real robots and full robotic systems: xArm6 and UR5 arms, the SO-101 with LeRobot, NVIDIA Jetson boards, and ROS tying it all together.

q: Robotics or AI? Research or engineering?
a: Both. I'm trained to think scientifically, and I understand the engineering it takes to make an idea work in the real world.
